injuries.name: Kingston Flemings
injuries.detail: Flemings (back) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bucks.

injuries.name: Keshon Gilbert
injuries.detail: Gilbert (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Bulls.

injuries.name: Asa Newell
injuries.detail: Newell (toe) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Chicago.

injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.detail: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.detail: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.detail: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

injuries.name: Dennis Schroder
injuries.detail: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries.name: Daniel Gafford
injuries.detail: Gafford (face) won't return to Saturday's game against the Cavaliers, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.

injuries.name: Max Christie
injuries.detail: Christie (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against Cleveland.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.detail: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Thursday's game in Minnesota.

injuries.name: Sergio de Larrea
injuries.detail: De Larrea (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game at Minnesota.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.detail: Biberovic (heel) is out for Thursday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Fred VanVleet
injuries.detail: VanVleet (right knee injury management) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Marcus Smart
injuries.detail: Smart has been suspended three games for throwing a punch during Wednesday's matchup against Golden State, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Steven Adams
injuries.detail: Adams (calf) has been upgraded to probable for Sunday's game against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Clint Capela
injuries.detail: Capela (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Washington.

injuries.name: Andrew Nembhard
injuries.detail: Nembhard is questionable for Sunday's game against the 76ers due to left hip soreness.

injuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton
injuries.detail: Head coach Rick Carlisle said Wednesday that Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least 10 more days, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Aaron Nesmith
injuries.detail: Nesmith (hand) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.

injuries.name: Johnny Furphy
injuries.detail: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.detail: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

injuries.name: T.J. McConnell
injuries.detail: McConnell (hamstring) is listed as probable for Sunday's game against the 76ers.

injuries.name: Brandon Ingram
injuries.detail: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Friday's game against the Thunder, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Bradley Beal
injuries.detail: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

injuries.name: Jordan Miller
injuries.detail: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
injuries.detail: Niederhauser (foot) is out for Tuesday's game against Phoenix, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Austin Reaves
injuries.detail: Reaves (heel) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Suns, Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com reports.

injuries.name: Collin Sexton
injuries.detail: Sexton (head) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Suns, Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com reports.

injuries.name: Adou Thiero
injuries.detail: Thiero (ankle) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Suns.

injuries.name: Ousmane Dieng
injuries.detail: Dieng (finger) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Hawks.

injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
injuries.detail: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

injuries.name: Ajay Mitchell
injuries.detail: Mitchell (ankle) is questionable to suit up for Sunday's game against the Kings.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMaho

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.detail: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Jaylin Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Kings.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.detail: Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Joel Embiid
injuries.detail: Embiid (right foot injury management) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Dominick Barlow
injuries.detail: Barlow (back) participated in Thursday's shootaround but doesn't have a timeline to return to game action, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Adem Bona
injuries.detail: Bona (back) will be re-evaluated in approximately one week after seeing a specialist, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Drew Timme
injuries.detail: The Suns claimed Timme off waivers Monday, per Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.detail: Harris (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Chicago, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.detail: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.detail: Raynaud (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Thunder.

injuries.name: Keegan Murray
injuries.detail: Murray (illness) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Thunder.

injuries.name: Precious Achiuwa
injuries.detail: Achiuwa (ankle) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Thunder.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons
injuries.detail: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

injuries.name: Scottie Barnes
injuries.detail: Barnes (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Knicks, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Kawhi Leonard
injuries.detail: Head coach Darko Rajakovic said Wednesday that Leonard (knee) is doing individual on-court work and is progressing well, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Kevin McCullar Jr.
injuries.detail: McCullar signed a two-way contract with the Raptors on Thursday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.detail: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Knicks, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Lauri Markkanen
injuries.detail: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injuries.detail: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.detail: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

injuries.name: Jaxson Hayes
injuries.detail: Hayes (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Spurs.

injuries.name: Trey Alexander
injuries.detail: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

injuries.name: Alex Sarr
injuries.detail: Sarr (illness) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Houston.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Tre Johnson
injuries.detail: Johnson is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Rockets due to lower-back soreness.

injuries.name: Justin Champagnie
injuries.detail: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Bub Carrington
injuries.detail: Carrington (chest) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Houston.

injuries.name: Reece Beekman
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.detail: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Detroit.
